responsibility: This definition module declares the low-level C-facing filesystem operation interface for gm2 libraries. It belongs to the operating-system interop layer and exports `ADDRESS`-based bindings for `Unlink`, `Access`, `Exists`, `IsDir`, and `IsFile`, along with the `AccessStatus`/`AccessMode` types that model `access(2)` permission probes and failure reporting, providing the raw pathname API that higher-level string wrappers adapt.
